reviews.title: AS2 second two-hour batch: media
reviews.reason: Bounded AS2-only delivery against385908d:310 unique reviewed entries,258new,9extended,43reviewed-existing. Constants, corrections and noncatalogue extensions are separated from149newmethod/property paths. AS3 audit remains unchanged.
reviews.limitations: Progressive browser video controllers attached through documented NeoFlash extensions to authored Video; Rust states, cue ordering, timing, sizing and stream measurements. HTML5 READY12/12, physical Play13/13 with actual20fps, two cues/completion/rewind, Restart12/12. No FLV/RTMP, skins, server buffers, multi-player component linkage or audible quality claim. Constants and inherited owner paths are not independent algorithms.

verification.browser: Codex in-app browser, actual native browser input/media/HTTP
verification.decision: Coordinator observed ordinary authored family HTML5 results described in limitations and reviewed final source bytes. Not an independent individual declaration or original Flash conformance run.
